lines.en: I walk, wings twitching behind me.

lines.zh: 掠夺者的步子，却走得很慢。
lines.en: Pillager legs, moving slowly.
I pass the village gate slowly.
My arms will barely lift.
I head toward the pillager tower.
Something inside me moves.
These steps do not feel like mine.
I steer clear of villagers.
I walk steadily. The wings never stop.
Along the road, straight on.
Scales of dust trail behind me.
I want to stop. My legs keep going.
I drag my crossbow, struggling.

lines.zh: 我走到树荫下，喘了一口。
lines.en: I reach the shade and breathe.

lines.zh: 我不是在巡逻，是被带着走。
lines.en: I am not patrolling. I am being carried.
I head where the people are.
Standing, my wings open and close.
My hands shake. I cannot hold the bow.

lines.zh: 我听见有人在里面说话。
lines.en: I hear something speaking inside.
I look up and it is not the sky I see.

lines.zh: 我很久没有自己想过事了。
lines.en: I have not had my own thoughts in a while.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛还能看，但不太清。
lines.en: My eyes still see, though dimly.
I stand in the road and do not move.

lines.zh: 翅膀的颜色很漂亮，对吧。
lines.en: The wing colors are pretty, are they not?

lines.zh: 我摸自己的胸口，摸到翅。
lines.en: I touch my chest and find a wing.
The village children are watching me.
I want to shout. Nothing comes.
I lean on the wall a while.
You can tell something is wrong.
I am not myself.
Help me, or kill me?

lines.zh: 我胸口这东西，动得很勤。
lines.en: The thing in my chest is restless.
Not too close. It dislikes that.

lines.zh: 你看我的翅膀，就知道了。
lines.en: Look at my wings. You will know.
A butterfly moves inside my head.
It walks me toward you.

lines.zh: 我的弩，我自己都拿不稳。
lines.en: I cannot even hold my own crossbow.

lines.zh: 你走吧，趁我还说得出话。
lines.en: Go, while I can still speak.
I hurt. It does not.
My blood is the wrong color.

lines.zh: 这一下，让我清醒了一瞬。
lines.en: For a moment, that woke me.
I steady myself on the wall.
Not the chest. It will come out.

lines.zh: 我的弩还举着，手却不听。
lines.en: My crossbow is up, but my arm will not obey.
Thank you for that.
The wingbeats faltered.
I can still speak. Good.
It pulled back, just under the skin.
I am not hungry. It is.

lines.zh: 我的嘴在动，可我不想吃。
lines.en: My mouth moves, but I don't want to eat.
It wants what you are holding.
Lower your hand. Do not let it see.

lines.zh: 我闻不到香味了，很久了。
lines.en: I have not smelled food in a long time.
Stay back. I cannot control it.
Eat the bread yourself.
When it stirs, I move.
Set it down and go.
Thanks. I do not need it.
Do not touch me. It wakes.

lines.zh: 我退开了，是它让我靠前。
lines.en: I stepped back. It pushed me forward.
You bumped two bodies at once.
My arms are heavy and will not lift.

lines.zh: 我撞在栅栏上，翅膀还在扇。
lines.en: I hit the fence; the wings still beat.
Three steps back and I can hold still.
The bump made it tighten.

lines.zh: 我的身体比看起来的轻。
lines.en: My body is lighter than it looks.
It likes contact. I do not.
Do not pull my hand. It will grab.
I cannot speak of that anymore.
I had a home, at the tower.

lines.zh: 这东西不要后代，只要宿主。
lines.en: It wants hosts, not children.
That question pains me.

lines.zh: 我记不起他们的样子了。
lines.en: I cannot recall their faces.
Stop. It is listening.

lines.zh: 这些事，它一点一点拿走了。
lines.en: It takes those things from me.
I am a shell now, not a living man.
Let me be quiet a moment.
Ask it, not me.

lines.zh: 我的弩掉了，我捡不起来。
lines.en: My crossbow fell. I cannot pick it up.
Pick it up, but not near my chest.
Those arrows on the ground are mine.
My hands will not obey.

lines.zh: 它想让我拿起那件东西。
lines.en: It wants me to pick that up.
Do not take it. It is bait.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的时候，翅膀张开了。
lines.en: When I bend, my wings spread.

lines.zh: 这块布上有灾厄的记号。
lines.en: That cloth bears the illager mark.
I pin it down so it stops moving.
Keep it. Do not leave it on the road.
It has seen you. Back away.

lines.zh: 我的手臂抬起来了，不是我。
lines.en: My arms rise. Not by me.
It wants a new host.
It likes your warmth.
I cannot stop it. Run.
The wings beat fast now.
I see it reaching out.

lines.zh: 它借我的手指扣上扳机。
lines.en: It uses my fingers to pull the trigger.

lines.zh: 它锁定了离得最近的人。
lines.en: It picks the nearest person.
My crossbow is aimed at you.
It circles around you.
My feet step toward you.
I try to stop. I cannot.

lines.zh: 它喜欢猎物喘气的样子。
lines.en: It likes the sound of prey panting.
My legs walk while I scream stop.
Wing dust settles on you.
The body is tireless. I am not.
It has your pace measured.
Two steps more and it is too late.

lines.zh: 我听见自己在说话，但不是我想说的。
lines.en: I hear my voice saying things I did not choose.
My hand struck you. I am sorry.
It threw that blow.
The crossbow stock hits your shoulder.
Stronger than I should be.
You pull back; it keeps reaching.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇起的粉让你咳嗽。
lines.en: The dust makes you cough.

lines.zh: 我抓了你的手腕，松不开。
lines.en: I caught your wrist. I cannot let go.
It is testing your body.
No hatred in that.
My nails have grown long.

lines.zh: 路口站着个掠夺者，不动。
lines.en: A pillager stands at the crossing, still.

lines.zh: 那件灰袍上有翅膀在动。
lines.en: Wings move on that grey robe.
Villagers shut their doors at my sight.

lines.zh: 我从灾厄的队伍里走散。
lines.en: I fell out of the illager column.

lines.zh: 你听见一阵很轻的扇动。
lines.en: A soft fluttering.
My chest begins to itch.
I stand on the road outside the village.
The wandering trader went around me.

lines.zh: 我曾经也这样站着，等他。
lines.en: I once stood like this, waiting.
It has made a home in me.

lines.zh: 火一烧，它在我胸口扭动。
lines.en: Fire makes it writhe in my chest.
I fell down the slope and crushed a wing.
Water goes in and it panics first.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀出去，它还在。
lines.en: The blast throws me clear. It remains.
An arrow in my back. I leave it.

lines.zh: 咒语让它的动作慢了下来。
lines.en: A spell slows its movements.
I stopped being able to eat long ago.

lines.zh: 雷击让我们两个一起抖。
lines.en: Lightning shakes us both.
In the void it clings tighter.
